> [!note] Archived
> The original version of [[Beast Of Omen (Familiar Archetype)|Beast Of Omen (Familiar Archetype)]], from before *Ultimate Spheres of Power*. Not part of the current rules.

**Shared Senses (Su):** Whenever the familiar’s master uses a Divination talent or ability granting himself a sense, he may also grant his familiar the sense.

This ability replaces share spells.
